metadata.case_name: LEUNG CHUN TUNG v. SIU WAI CHEONG

plaintiff.occupation_before: Office assistant and driver (South African Airways)
plaintiff.occupation_after: Warehouse supervisor; sales representative; distributing officer; casual public light bus (PLB) driver
plaintiff.education_level: Formal education up to Primary Four; attended evening school and completed Form One of secondary school

injuries.description: fractured left ilium and acetabulum with dislocation of left hip
source: X-ray photographs showed fractured left ilium and acetabulum with dislocation of left hip.
injuries.icd_description: Multiple injuries of hip or thigh

injuries.description: avascular necrosis of the femoral head resulting in collapse and flattening
source: There is also avascular necrosis of the femoral head resulting in collapse and flattening.
injuries.icd_description: Other specified injuries to the hip or thigh

injuries.description: incongruity and instability of the joint resulting in gross subluxation of the demoral head; advanced degenerative changes of the left hip
source: There is incongruity and instability of the joint resulting in gross subluxation of the demoral head.
Advanced degenerative changes have already occurred (only 7 years from the accident).

manifestations.description: Gross subluxation of the femoral head (radiological sign)
Collapse and flattening of the femoral head (radiological sign)
Reduced mobility / much reduced degree of mobility
Progressive deterioration of the left hip with need for total hip replacement in the next few years
Unable to sit for long periods

treatments_received.treatment: Open reduction of the fractured areas
source: On 16`th` March 1990, open reduction of the fractured areas was performed.
treatments_received.vmis_procedure: Open reduction for arm / leg / patella / scapula +/- internal fixation

source: On 23`rd` October 1990, arthroscopy of the left hip was performed.

treatments_received.treatment: Removal of left iliac crest plate
source: On 29`th` April 1991, the left ilicar crest plate was removed.
To improve the pain and stiffness of his left hip, he will need total joint replacement within the next few years' time.
The Plaintiff would have to undergo at least one primary and one revisional operation. The maximum operations would be four.

losses.description: Permanent damage to left hip resulting in significant permanent disability (assessed at 50% permanent disability)
Much reduced degree of mobility of left hip joint; progressive deterioration expected

losses.category: Loss of ability to engage in sports and hobbies
losses.description: Activities curtailed: was a kung fu instructor and scout master; canoeing and wind-surfing activities curtailed by his injuries

comparable_cases.case_name: Chan Pui Kei v. Leung On & KMB
comparable_cases.injury_description: Range for substantial injury as approved by the Court of Appeal: $540,000 to $660,000
